name: open_high_low_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, a 5-second bar where open equals low (every tick at or above open) reveals aggressive institutional buying that absorbed all resting sell orders at that price level — the index found no sellers willing to offer below the opening price of that 5-second window. When accompanied by elevated relative volume (>1.5× the 5-minute rolling mean), it confirms a genuine demand imbalance rather than thin-market drift. Institutional TWAP algorithms executing buy orders in NIFTY futures create these patterns as they systematically lift offers, and the order typically spans multiple 5-second windows, driving the index 8-15 spot points higher over the next 30-90 seconds. The complementary open=high bar identifies the equivalent sell-side imbalance.
core_signal_oneliner: 5-second bar where open equals low (or open equals high) with above-average volume, indicating complete one-sided order flow absorption and imminent continuation
